ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 85% low-intensity black pixels to 15% high-intensity white pixels, including features and base splash.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of high-contrast linear marks. The right lobe contains at least four parallel horizontal rake marks and several crossing diagonal lines. The left lobe displays a single prominent vertical linear disruption near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white rake marks (parallel linear scars) on the central-right ventral surface and heavy barnacle encrustation on the distal tips.
